meta.source: Sleeper public-league trades (local corpus), 2-team no-pick trade sides, QB/RB/WR/TE
meta.units: points above replacement per game, league scoring
meta.sign: hype = price - value; positive = the market paid more than our value. In player_weeks, price and value are medians over the trades that week and hype is their difference. cells.median_hype is the median of per-trade (price - value), a different aggregate.
meta.value_definition: consensus forecast (n*season ppg + k*ADP ppg)/(n+k) minus league replacement ppg; ADP->ppg curves and k fit leave-target-season-out on 2021-2024 (never 2025)
